metadata.description: Build an app with your own agent on your agent.cloud canvas.

plugins.name: canvas
plugins.description: Your apps on a canvas beside the chat: /canvas puts the app you are working on there, live from your machine, and your own Claude or Codex builds new versions with you.

plugins.name: canvas-e2e
plugins.description: Test build, for canvas-e2e.agent.cloud. Your own Claude or Codex builds your app with you on your agent.cloud canvas: it tries versions that differ on purpose, asks you at the forks that matter, and shows each one live.

plugins.name: canvas-v1
plugins.description: The earlier agent.cloud canvas (canvas.agent.cloud): your own Claude or Codex builds apps with you, one round of versions at a time.
